old_v2_semantics_audit.interval_policy: all RK stages over [t_i,t_(i+1)] reconstruct against saved field F_i
old_v2_semantics_audit.field_model: piecewise constant in time over each saved interval
old_v2_semantics_audit.substep_effect: substeps reduce RK quadrature error for the frozen F_i field but do not remove the O(delta_t_saved) temporal hold consistency bias when the reference field changes in time
old_v2_semantics_audit.time_error_statement: for a smooth time-dependent reference field, piecewise-constant hold has first-order global temporal consistency in the saved-frame interval; this is a semantic audit, not a measured bound
old_v2_semantics_audit.future_access: none beyond current saved frame, but no endpoint temporal evolution is represented

new_v3_semantics.interval_policy: stage at time tau in [t_i,t_(i+1)] reads exactly registered endpoint arrays F_i and F_(i+1)
new_v3_semantics.endpoint_policy: exact endpoint fields at alpha=0 or 1; no extrapolation
new_v3_semantics.future_policy: a right endpoint is permitted only because it is the registered endpoint of the current integration interval; no following interval or model CFD state is exposed
new_v3_semantics.trajectory_policy: native particle positions are linearly interpolated as support geometry; the tracer path is the independent RK4 state; row correspondence is checked by identical valid fluid native indices
new_v3_semantics.model_source_policy: provider opens only the registered reference source H5; model/future CFD fields are forbidden
new_v3_semantics.time_error_statement: RK4 quadrature sees a time-dependent linearly interpolated field; with a smooth spatial reconstruction its quadrature error is higher order inside an interval, while the piecewise-linear saved-field representation remains a separate O(delta_t_saved^2) global modeling error under smoothness assumptions; no material error bound is claimed
new_v3_semantics.substep_interpretation: substeps test RK quadrature of the same v3 time field; they do not make the piecewise-linear reference field or whole trace fourth-order in time
